content:
We need to issue a tool call correctly. Let's do:

<thought>Search for templates that involve breaking a C-C triple bond and a ketone (functional groups broken) without specifying bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
